<!--
The shape every issue in this repository takes. What happens / Where / Why it
matters are the part that describes the problem; Test / Fix / Acceptance are the
part that says what closing it means. Delete the Open question section when
there is none.
-->

## What happens

What the app does today.

## Where

The screens, the files, the functions — line references help.

## Why it matters

Who is stopped, and by what.

## Test

The test that would pin it: the file, the case, what it asserts. A bug fix ships
with a test that fails on the unmodified code, so say here what that test does
before the fix.

## Fix

The change, as far as it is known: the seam it goes in, not the whole design.

## Acceptance

The sentence that is true when the issue is done.

## Open question

What should be decided rather than assumed.
